notes: GPIO21 and GPIO47 are shared I2S clock signals for microphone and amplifier.
GPIO41 receives microphone SD; GPIO42 sends DOUT to MAX98357A DIN.
The current firmware includes the I2S microphone RX driver; earlier headless-stage notes are obsolete.
OLED remains on GPIO1/2 and is enabled by the current HW04 board profile.
COM6 (flash) and COM4 (panel) are example Windows ports observed on the reference PC; enumerate ports on each host.
